fato_historico: 1994: A Trans World Airlines McDonnell Douglas MD-80 and Cessna 441 Conquest II aircraft collide on the runway at St. Louis Lambert International Airport in Bridgeton, Missouri, killing two people and injuring eight.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel a gentle nudge to prioritize safety and mindful coordination in your busy life. Like a runway cleared for a smooth takeoff, it is a good time to clear away mental clutter. Perhaps you will find peace by double-checking the small details, ensuring everything is aligned for a safe and successful journey forward.
frase_do_dia: True progress is found when we move with intention and a steady, calm heart.
significado_numero: A powerful number representing double mastery and building foundations with great care.
conselho: Consider pausing today to ensure all your plans are aligned before moving ahead quickly.
